title: Bookkeeper
description:

title: Digital Marketing Manager
company: North Yorkshire Hospice Care - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Manager
Permanent Contract
Location: Hybrid, Crimple House, Hornbeam Park Avenue, Harrogate, HG2 8 NA
Hours: 37.5 hours
Salary: £39,556.25 per annum
Closing date: 31st October 2026 (the advert may close early if we receive a sufficient number of suitable applications)
Brand: Herriot Hospice Homecare, Just 'B' and Saint Michael's

Do you want to be part of an organisation that makes a real difference to our local communities? Our family of services including Herriot Hospice Homecare, Just 'B' and Saint Michael's Hospice provide vital support to people when they need it most. Our vision is of a community where everyone gets the care they need, want and deserve You can help make that a reality.

We are an independent charity powered by local communities. Every day, we help to improve quality of life for people living with terminal illness, bereavement and mental health concerns, because our belief is that no one should suffer. Our incredible teams work together to make this happen.

About the role
As Digital Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in maximising the impact of digital marketing across North Yorkshire Hospice Care, helping to grow awareness of our services, engage supporters and generate sustainable fundraising income. You will lead the development and delivery of a coordinated digital marketing strategy across Saint Michael's Hospice, Herriot Hospice and Just 'B', overseeing campaigns across websites, social media, email, search and paid advertising. Using creativity, audience insight and performance data, you will optimise digital activity to increase donations, fundraising participation and supporter engagement. Working collaboratively with colleagues across fundraising, marketing and clinical services, you will ensure our digital channels deliver measurable results and support our wider organisational goals. You will also provide specialist digital expertise and, in time, recruit and manage the Digital Marketing Officer, helping to strengthen our digital capabilities and secure the future of our vital hospice, bereavement and emotional wellbeing services.

About You
We are looking for a strategic, creative and results-driven digital marketing professional with significant experience developing and delivering successful multi-channel digital marketing strategies. You will have strong technical knowledge across website management, SEO, paid search and social media, email marketing and digital advertising, alongside experience using analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to measure performance and improve results. With a commercial mindset and a focus on continuous improvement, you will be confident managing budgets, multiple campaigns and competing priorities, ensuring digital activity delivers measurable impact and value for money. You will have excellent communication, copywriting and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues, agencies and external partners. A proactive and innovative approach, strong attention to detail and an understanding of digital fundraising, supporter journeys, accessibility and data protection are essential. Above all, you will be passionate about using digital marketing to make a meaningful difference and help North Yorkshire Hospice Care reach more people, build lasting supporter relationships and generate the income needed to deliver its vital services.

How we look after you
- We put people first in all that we do, which includes our own team
- Wellbeing and resilience support with a dedicated team by your side
- Flexible and hybrid working for many roles
- A supportive and caring environment
- Opportunities to grow, develop and progress, with culture of lifelong learning
- Benefits include 9% employer pension contribution, enhanced family leave and pay, generous annual leave, staff discount on our online shop, shopping and lifestyle discounts platform.

Harrogate

- Provide graphic design and artwork support, helping manage and complete artwork requests and amendments. Complete artwork tasks such as flyers, business cards, certificates, CPD materials, minor product collateral amends, sales support documents and sector-specific templates. Assisting the Graphic Designer Lead on larger creative projects, such as product launches, packaging and new marketing materials.

- Highly organised with strong time-management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive attitude towards learning and developing new skills.

title: Payroll/Finance Administrator
description:
Full Job description

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organised and motivated Payroll/Finance Administrator to join our finance team in our head office in Harrogate.

Job Purpose:

Reporting to the Finance Manager, the Payroll / Finance Administrator is responsible for managing employee pay and supporting financial operations within an organisation. The role combines payroll processing with broader finance and administrative duties

Key Responsibilities
- Calculate wages, salaries, bonuses, and deductions
- Check and monitor commission calculations
- Ensure employees are paid accurately and on time
- Manage overtime, sick pay, and holiday pay with assistance of HR Department.
- Ensure payroll complies with tax laws (e.g. PAYE, National Insurance)
- Submit reports to HMRC and maintain payroll records
- Assist with budgeting and forecasting
- Process invoices and expenses
- Reconcile accounts and support audits
- Handle payroll queries and maintain employee records
- Input manual timesheets into payroll software
- Input payroll costs into project costing system
- Adhoc Financial Duties as required.

Key Skills
- Strong numerical and analytical skills
- Attention to detail and accuracy
- Knowledge of payroll systems (e.g. Sage, Xero, QuickBooks)
- Understanding of UK tax and employment regulations
- Good communication skills and confidentiality

Experience
- Background in accounting, finance, or business administration
- Experience with spreadsheets and financial software
